content:
Tessa: Final sync before announce tomorrow. Need final changelog URL, docs anchor, webinar CTA, and confirm inbound routing. Can eng confirm deploy and canary timing? :clock1:

Marco: Canary ok from our side. Start 08:00 PT at 10%, bump to 45% at 08:12, full at 08:40 if healthy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4938. Rollback if error rate >4% sustained over 5m.

Neil: Docs ready at /docs/releases/2026-03-announce. I'll add a #changelog anchor and publish at 07:50 PT so marketing links are live pre-canary.

Hana: Webinar CTA is set: https://events.redwood.com/mar-launch-signup. HubSpot form attached and UTM tagging added. I'll also attach the short benchmark highlight for the tweet.

Tessa: Good. Routing needs: blog CTA -> nurture-marketing, demo requests -> sdr-bench, webinar -> webinar-nurture. Marco can you provide a fallback webhook for high-load?

Marco: Adding secondary webhook and retry policy. Snippet:
```
webhook:
  primary: https://hooks.sfdc.redwood.com/lead
  backup: https://hooks-backup.sfdc.redwood.com/lead
  retries: 4
  backoff_ms: 250
```
Will push in 45m.

Neil: Marketing asked for one-line benchmark for copy: p50 for 1k tokens on dedicated-gpu.a1 = ~175ms. Use carefully with caveat about long context p95.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by @Marco for 2026-03-24 08:00:00 PT  canary start. CI checks passed.

Tessa: Final checklist:
- [ ] publish docs anchor (Neil 07:50 PT)
- [ ] webhooks + routing (Marco +45m)
- [ ] webinar CTA live (Hana done)
- [ ] social copy + benchmark stat (Tessa/marketing)
I'll create the #release-mar-24 channel 30m before canary. Any last blockers? :white_check_mark:

Marco: No blockers. I'll post webhook confirmation when pushed.

Hana: All set on webinar side. Removing speaker notes 07:40 PT.

Tessa: Thanks team — will drop final links here in 20m. :tada:
